title: EXT_state_series channel
description: One time-series channel: an accessor (count == len(times)) of up to 4 feature dims, describing a `kind`-named quantity about the glTF object identified by `pointer`.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) identifying the glTF object this channel's quantity is about, resolved with the same rules KHR_animation_pointer uses for its own `pointer` extension property (traversal through `extensions`/`extras` permitted; a pointer resolves to a location that is defined explicitly or by a present enclosing object's spec default). Unlike KHR_animation_pointer, this identifies an object (e.g. "/nodes/3"), not a specific animated property -- `kind` supplies the quantity.

kind.description: The quantity this channel carries: a registered vocabulary entry, or a vendor-specific x-* kind.

accessor.description: Index of the accessor holding this channel's data (SCALAR/VEC2/VEC3/VEC4, float32, count == len(times)).

component.description: 0-based chunk index, present only when a kind's natural feature width exceeds 4 and had to be split across multiple accessors/channels of the same kind+pointer. Decode concatenates chunks in ascending component order.

units.description: UCUM-style unit string (e.g. "m/s", "rad/s", "N"). If omitted, the kind's registered default unit applies.

frame.description: Reference frame of a vector-valued channel's components. Required for linear_velocity/angular_velocity/applied_force/applied_torque/pose_variance; MUST NOT be present for action/joint_position/joint_velocity.

sampling.description: "sampled" (default): a recorded observation at each times[i], no implied inter-sample interpolation. "interpolable": values MAY be meaningfully interpolated between samples.

temporalCorrelation.description: Optional temporal-correlation metadata, meaningful primarily for pose_variance channels. Absence does NOT imply i.i.d. samples -- it means no claim is made about temporal structure.

model.description: Correlation model identifier. v0 of this extension defines exactly one: lag-1 autoregressive.
